style: Dravidian shrines and sculpture from several phases of the Srisailam complex
key_structures: Four cardinal gopuras in the rectangular stone prakara
Eastern Nandi Mandapa, Veerasiro Mandapa and Mallikarjuna Jyotirlinga
Bhramaramba Devi's elevated western enclosure and two-tier vimana
Pancha Sivalaya and Nava Brahma rows with shared porticoes
special_features: Rare holy confluence of a major Jyotirlinga and a Maha Shakti Peetha within a single fortified complex
The stone prakara carries narrative reliefs, including the documented south-wall animal procession
The goddess's vimana has niches recorded as Durga, Vaishnavi and Brahmi
materials: Gold sheet coverings on vimana and dhwaja stambha
period: Historic complex with medieval fabric and later rebuilding
renovation_history: The complex preserves several building phases, including Kakatiya, Reddi and Vijayanagara work. A published structural study records the failure of the north Shivaji Gopura in 2012.
